name: Iridic-Skerry
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against a tidally locked hemisphere, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the ancient alien ruins left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
